scene.note: Stream channel flowing downstream toward a stone arch culvert.

findings.question: channel_form
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel cross-section: steep right bank and vertical masonry left wall create a U-shaped channel.

findings.question: bottom_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel bed: dark brownish water and surface ripples prevent seeing the bed clearly.

findings.question: bank_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left bank: vertical stone wall with mortar dominates the channel edge.

findings.question: habitats
findings.evidence: downstream photo, foreground: shallow water with ripples and small fast drops creates riffles.

findings.question: natural_debris
findings.evidence: downstream photo, lower center: a fallen branch sticks out across the water surface.

findings.question: water_flow
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel: water shows continuous ripples and white water indicating fast flow.

findings.question: water_aspect
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel: dark brown water that prevents seeing into the riverbed.

findings.question: water_withdrawal
findings.evidence: downstream photo, full view: no abstraction pipes, pumps, or collection equipment visible.

findings.question: barriers
findings.evidence: downstream photo, center: the stone culvert arches freely over the stream without an artificial transversal sill or dam.

findings.question: draining_pipes
findings.evidence: downstream photo, banks and culvert: no visible draining pipes discharging water.

findings.question: sewage_discharge
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel: no sewage entry points or sewage discharges visible.

findings.question: construction
findings.evidence: downstream photo, full view: no active machinery, scaffolding, or works in progress.

findings.question: impervious_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin: stone houses and paved areas occupy more than a third of the margin.

findings.question: impervious_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right margin: the bank and upper slope are completely covered by natural soil and vegetation.

findings.question: vegetation_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin: shrubs and garden plants are present along the bank top.

findings.question: vegetation_type_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left banktop: large rounded shrubs cover most of the vegetated banktop area.

findings.question: vegetation_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right margin: continuous plant cover on the entire bank slope.

findings.question: vegetation_type_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right bank: brambles and woody shrubs dominate the first 5 meters from the banktop.

findings.question: vegetation_cut
findings.evidence: downstream photo, banks: no freshly cut vegetation, cleared stems, or mown strips are visible.
